player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Wild Tic Tac Toe.
On your turn, you can place either an 'X' or an 'O' in an empty square.
You win by aligning three of the same mark (X or O) in a row.
You can win with either symbol.
Choose your move using the format '[X 4]' to place X in the center.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Use '[X 4]' or '[O 2]' format.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Inambala ya cell iyabula insambu: {cell}. Ifwile ukuba pakati ka 0 na 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ukubombako kwabula insambu. cell {cell} yalikwata abantu kale.

game_action.placed: Mwina {player_id} akabela symbol yake ({mark}) mu selo {cell}
